name: apple-reminders
description: Read and manage Apple Reminders on macOS via EventKit.
long_description: Local MCP server that exposes Apple Reminders to Claude through a Swift/EventKit CLI. Supports reading lists and reminders, due-date queries (today, overdue, completed), full-text search, and full CRUD on reminders including recurring rules and location triggers, plus creating, renaming, recoloring, and deleting lists.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a new reminder with title, notes, due date, priority, recurrence, location triggers, and alarms.

tools.name: update_reminder
tools.description: Update fields on an existing reminder.

tools.name: get_reminders
tools.description: List reminders, optionally filtered by completion state and list.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a new Reminders list, optionally with a color and account.

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Rename or recolor a Reminders list.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Permanently delete a Reminders list and all reminders in it.

tools.name: search_reminders
tools.description: Full-text search across reminder titles and notes.

tools.name: get_completed_reminders
tools.description: Get completed reminders, optionally within a date range.

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Trigger the macOS Reminders permission prompt. Run once before using other tools if access has not yet been granted.
